Gold Dagger 2019

Shortlisted

Donna Leon

Unto Us a Son is Given

Published by: William Heinemann

  • Amazon

Leon’s cast of well-established and familiar characters are on hand in this delve into the depths of human weaknesses as jealousies, greed and mistrust abound in a devilish plot that twists and turns as it unfolds. Much coffee and wine is drunk and delightful food eaten before you are shocked back into the turmoil of the mystery and the foibles of human nature as it speeds towards its unforeseeable resolution.
